listing.name: Tekken: Dark Resurrection (PSP) — tkdr-recomp (gasparegas)
listing.summary: fights at 60 FPS/up-to 4×, according to upstream; original PSP title distinct from PS3 Dark Resurrection Online. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: USA ULUS10139 v1.00 ISO/CSO plus your own decrypted EBOOT

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: local CMake/Ninja/SDL2 native build; the browser can translate on the device; the original ISO and decrypted EBOOT remain required.

warnings: fights at 60 FPS/up-to 4×, according to upstream; original PSP title distinct from PS3 Dark Resurrection Online.
